'''Nath ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Gehn's Overlook]] on [[Voss]], where he sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
